candidate_state: Exact-ranking/runtime/SQL follow-up inspected; final source identity and validation are recorded in the current report.
overall: Source-grounded architecture dictionary. This is not proof of running AWS behavior, database parity, order execution, every-tick capture or universal O(1).
conclusions: Yes: reading the already-published highest row can avoid the DB and stay constant in board length.
No: building all rankings, processing all input, emitting all rows and all timeframes cannot be independent of their sizes.
The current volume percentage uses one lot as baseline; it is not growth versus previous candle.
Candidate exact ratio ranking resolves rounded ties; display columns remain quantized.
Four ranking cadences and separate stock/index families;24 computed candle frames but12 emitted frames.
Snapshot sweep time and candle bucket time are different; precise every-bucket parity remains unimplemented.
No production automated trading reader, top-volume API or dedicated frontend found.

formulas.different_previous_window_definition: 100 * (current_window_volume - previous_window_volume) / previous_window_volume; undefined when previous_window_volume=0 unless policy says otherwise
formulas.precision_note: Exact score sorting does not make its rounded display exact. Keep numerator/denominator for audit.

base_table.name: top_volume
base_table.rank_column: Not in current create/append/view. Legacy existing column is not automatically dropped.

fields.name: ts
fields.unit: IST wall-clock convention; ILP input nanoseconds; values on whole cadence boundary
fields.purpose: Identify the published snapshot. It is not the source tick timestamp and not a candle-open timestamp.
fields.populated_by: snapshot_top_volume passes now_ist_nanos(); floor_to_grid rounds down to the cadence grid anchored at 09:00 IST. Projection uses the same floor.
fields.missing_or_edge: The label does not encode actual observed interval start/end or missed sweeps. A delayed sweep combines deltas since the previous sweep. RAM refuses nonpositive/off-grid/older values; same-boundary replacement is permitted.
fields.ordering_role: Newest snapshot DESC before per-family ranking; part of UPSERT identity

fields.name: tf
fields.purpose: Tell which independent cumulative baseline produced the row.
fields.populated_by: SnapshotCadence::as_str; four cadence timers feed four per-contract baseline slots.
fields.missing_or_edge: These are the only ranking cadences. The24 candle variants do not automatically create24 ranking boards.
fields.ordering_role: Part of UPSERT identity and per-cadence view filter

fields.name: family
fields.purpose: Keep stock and index option populations separate.
fields.populated_by: ContractOwner family is passed to VolumeLeaderboard::observe; snapshot loop publishes Index and Stock independently; OptionFamily::as_str stores label.
fields.missing_or_edge: There is no combined all-options winner. Family is not a price/volume signal.
fields.ordering_role: Family ASC separates boards; part of UPSERT identity

fields.name: feed
fields.purpose: Preserve source provenance and avoid identity collisions between brokers.
fields.missing_or_edge: A second feed is not automatically covered. Current producer supplies only Dhan.
fields.ordering_role: Part of UPSERT identity; final SQL tie key

fields.name: segment
fields.purpose: Disambiguate reused security IDs across segments.
fields.populated_by: ParsedTick exchange code→ExchangeSegment→as_str; retained with each ranked identity.
fields.missing_or_edge: Unknown segments do not enter the owner lookup/ranking. SQL maps recognized segment names to the Rust enum ordinal for ties.
fields.ordering_role: True-score tie break after security_id; part of UPSERT identity

fields.name: contract
fields.purpose: Show underlying, expiry, strike and CE/PE together without a live join.
fields.populated_by: contract_label renders artifact metadata once at map publish; labels_from_artifact builds a composite-ID map; projection borrows the label from one snapshot.
fields.missing_or_edge: Missing label writes unmapped and increments label_unavailable; numeric identity survives. Oversized labels are bounded and marked. Invalid expiry is rendered visibly, not invented.
fields.ordering_role: Display only; not an UPSERT or sorting key

fields.name: security_id
fields.purpose: Identify the exact option contract; needed for joins/subscriptions.
fields.populated_by: ParsedTick.security_id retained by RankedContract; projection checked-converts u64→i64.
fields.missing_or_edge: IDs above i64::MAX are refused as id_too_large rather than wrapped negative.
fields.ordering_role: True-score tie break ASC; part of UPSERT identity

fields.name: underlying_id
fields.purpose: Connect the option to its equity or index for contextual price gain and distinct-underlying depth selection.
fields.populated_by: ContractOwner.underlying_id from artifact map; carried through RankedContract.
fields.missing_or_edge: Missing owner means the tick does not enter this ranking. IDs above i64::MAX are refused in projection.
fields.ordering_role: Context/grouping for depth200; never primary volume order

fields.name: volume
fields.unit: provider cumulative day-volume counter; source u32
fields.purpose: Retain the cumulative observation used to form this snapshot for audit.
fields.missing_or_edge: First positive observation seeds baselines; it is not all charged to the first window. Zero counters are ignored. Lower values follow the documented32-lower-observation re-latch policy.
fields.ordering_role: Not a sort key: would measure busy-since-open, not activity in this observed interval

fields.name: delta_units
fields.unit: nonnegative incremental provider volume units; source u32
fields.purpose: Store the numerator of the volume ratio and the activity observed since this cadence was last swept.
fields.populated_by: rank computes latest accepted cumulative minus this contract/cadence baseline using saturating_sub, then advances that baseline.
fields.missing_or_edge: Zero delta is omitted. Missing first-history interval, counter reset ambiguity and merged delayed sweeps cannot be inferred away. Provider units must agree with lot_size for the normalization to mean lots.
fields.ordering_role: Exact primary ordering numerator (candidate); not signed buy-minus-sell net volume

fields.name: lot_size
fields.purpose: Normalize different contracts to comparable traded-lot ratios.
fields.populated_by: Dhan instrument-master LOT_SIZE→artifact row.z→ContractOwner.lot_size→accepted RankedContract; rank uses carried value and only falls back to lookup when zero.
fields.missing_or_edge: Missing/zero lot-size owner rows are refused; divisor never silently defaults to 1. Existing source does not certify live provider volume units from divisibility alone.

fields.name: window_lots_milli
fields.purpose: Provide a compact fixed-point display of the interval activity and a consistency check on delta/lot.
fields.missing_or_edge: Quantized downward to 0.001 lot. Candidate keeps a positive sub-milli delta even when this display field is0. Projection checks signed-domain conversion.
fields.ordering_role: Coarse radix grouping/display. Exact ratio refinement resolves equal displayed buckets in candidate. Baseline af77 used this as entire primary key.

fields.name: net_volume_chg_milli_pct
fields.purpose: Expose a stored percentage display that does not require the operator to calculate it.
fields.populated_by: window_lots_milli*100-100000; shown as percent after dividing by1000.
fields.missing_or_edge: Still quantized to 0.1 percentage-point steps because the input is milli-lots. Positive sub-milli activity can display -100.000%. It is not prior-candle percentage growth and not tick-rule signed net flow.
fields.ordering_role: Approximate display of the exact one-lot-baseline score; no longer sufficient for exact ranking ties

fields.name: gain_pct
fields.unit: percentage points of underlying price change from previous close
fields.purpose: Show whether the option underlying is up/down today, separately from traded-volume activity.
fields.populated_by: underlying_gain_pct reads spot_prices.latest_paise and previous close converted to paise. underlying_segment uses IDX_I for index and NSE_EQ for stock; eligible_gain_pct computes100*(spot-prev_close)/prev_close.
fields.missing_or_edge: Missing/nonpositive/nonfinite inputs or implausible magnitude > 1000% give NULL and gain_unavailable count; volume row remains. Stores are latest RAM values, not historical as-of joins per option tick.
fields.ordering_role: Context only in full board; positive gain controls separate stock-depth eligibility

fields.name: subscribed
fields.purpose: Record whether a depth pool last reported holding this exact contract when projected.
fields.populated_by: DepthSubscriptionView::is_subscribed probes last-published depth20 OR depth200 membership maps.
fields.missing_or_edge: False at initial empty view. This flag is not an upstream acknowledgment, socket freshness, tick receipt or active order. Concurrent membership can change during a sweep; no row carries a membership-version timestamp.

extra_or_renamed_columns.name: symbol_name
extra_or_renamed_columns.meaning: Current master symbol joined by contract security_id+segment+feed.
extra_or_renamed_columns.missing: NULL if no non-dry-run lifecycle row. Because lifecycle is updated in place, a later query of history can show newer metadata.

extra_or_renamed_columns.name: display_name
extra_or_renamed_columns.meaning: Current master display label; complements the persisted full contract string.
extra_or_renamed_columns.missing: Same LEFT JOIN behavior; no row is removed solely because labels are unavailable.

extra_or_renamed_columns.name: instrument_type
extra_or_renamed_columns.meaning: Current master type, such as option classification.
extra_or_renamed_columns.missing: NULL if no matching non-dry-run metadata.

extra_or_renamed_columns.name: window_lots
extra_or_renamed_columns.meaning: Human units for stored milli-lots; a rounded presentation value.
extra_or_renamed_columns.missing: It cannot restore the fraction discarded when milli-lots were calculated.

extra_or_renamed_columns.name: net_volume_chg_pct
extra_or_renamed_columns.meaning: Displayed volume percentage versus one lot.
extra_or_renamed_columns.missing: A rounded value, not the exact ratio comparator; can print the same for distinctly ordered rows.

extra_or_renamed_columns.name: underlying_chg_pct
extra_or_renamed_columns.meaning: Unambiguous display alias for underlying PRICE percentage.
extra_or_renamed_columns.missing: NULL means unavailable, not0% and not a reason to drop the volume row.

views.caveat: Live QuestDB DDL/query execution pending. Arbitrary outer queries should use explicit order to guarantee the order they need.

ram.current_decision_integration: Accessor provided but no production trading reader found; stock 5s drives separate depth-subscription selection.
ram.freshness: Board label age only; no per-instrument completeness guarantee

functions.name: contract_label / labels_from_artifact
functions.behavior: Build stable human labels once per artifact publish.
functions.limitation: Allocates on cold path; labels bounded and visibly truncated.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: ContractUnderlyingMap::owner_of
functions.behavior: Map composite contract ID to family, underlying and lot size.
functions.limitation: Missing owner excludes ranking; expected complexity is not adversarial worst-case proof.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: LiveIngest::ingest_tick_at
functions.behavior: Validate capture sequence, fold candle engine, persist acceptable tick, then call ranking observer only for fully accepted ticks.
functions.complexity: O(pipeline work); candle fold O(T), T=24
functions.limitation: Some invalid/stale-day ticks are deliberately refused. Slot-exhausted ticks can persist while not ranking/folding. Not all received packets become ticks rows.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: LiveIngest::observe_for_ranking
functions.behavior: Skip replay; resolve owner; carry raw cumulative volume and metadata into family board.
functions.complexity: Expected O(1) identity lookup plus observer
functions.limitation: Does not rebuild historical rankings from raw WAL replay.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: VolumeLeaderboard::observe
functions.behavior: Insert/advance tracked volume and mark each affected cadence dirty once; unchanged volume no-op; apply lower-volume re-latch policy.
functions.complexity: Expected O(1) for fixed 4 cadences; O(T) if cadence count scales
functions.limitation: 25,000 contracts/family ceiling; new insertion/cold allocations and exceptional logging are not fixed nanosecond work.32-lower policy cannot distinguish all vendor resets/replays.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: VolumeLeaderboard::roll_baselines
functions.behavior: Consume each cadence dirty list and advance baselines without sorting.
functions.limitation: Keeps pre-open accumulation out of first ranked interval; does not create missing observations.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: window_lots_milli
functions.behavior: Compute floor(delta*1000/lot) with zero-divisor refusal.
functions.limitation: Output loses sub-milli fractional detail; candidate exact comparison separately preserves order.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: VolumeLeaderboard::rank
functions.behavior: Consume dirty indices; compute delta and roll baseline even if ineligible; include positive valid deltas; sort full population; truncate only if caller requests k.
functions.complexity: O(D+R) for candidate fixed-width radix/refinement, not O(1)
functions.limitation: Actual caller requests all rows. Sweep intervals are processing intervals, not guaranteed candle buckets.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: compare_ranked_contracts
functions.behavior: Compare delta_a*lot_b versus delta_b*lot_a in u128, descending; true ties security_id then segment ordinal ascending.
functions.complexity: O(1) per comparison at current widths
functions.limitation: Inputs bounded positive u32; whole ranking still scales withR.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: sort_by_exact_volume_ratio / ranking_sort::sort
functions.behavior: Sort coarse milli-lot integer groups then refine unequal ratios inside each rounded tie by 64 fraction bits.
functions.complexity: O(R) fixed-width keys, with fixed small-group comparison cutoffs
functions.limitation: Exactness proof depends on denominator <= u32::MAX. Candidate Rust tests and AWS latency must validate implementation.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: LiveIngest::snapshot_top_volume
functions.behavior: Gate capture hours; rank each family; publish complete immutable RAM board; form stock 5s depth candidates; optionally project and append DB rows.
functions.limitation: Writer absence does not prevent RAM board publication. Timers may merge intervals after lag.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: nanos_to_next_grid_boundary / floor_to_grid
functions.behavior: Align cadence timer and snapshot labels on09:00 IST grid.
functions.limitation: Scheduler delay and NTP movement are separate. A grid label is not proof of interval contents or candle parity.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: within_capture_window
functions.behavior: Allow top-volume snapshots09:15:00 inclusive to15:40:00 exclusive.
functions.limitation: Uses wall-clock session label; does not certify full exchange coverage.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: underlying_gain_pct / eligible_gain_pct
functions.behavior: Compute underlying move versus previous close using current RAM stores.
functions.limitation: Not the volume score; missing/implausible values unavailable.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: gainer_eligible_for_depth
functions.behavior: Preserve volume order while retaining positive underlying gainers; independently fill contract and distinct-underlying candidate lists.
functions.complexity: O(R) scan, with expected O(1) per-underlying memo probes
functions.limitation: Full persisted/RAM board is unfiltered. Depth20 entry 250 / exit 300; depth200 entry 5 / exit 20. This chooses market-data subscriptions, not trading orders.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: DepthSubscriptionView::is_subscribed
functions.behavior: Read depth20/depth200 last-published membership.
functions.limitation: Does not prove provider acknowledgment or healthy live data; maps updated concurrently.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: TopVolumeRuntime::publish_snapshot
functions.behavior: Validate grid, exact order, positive delta, valid divisor, score consistency and older-timestamp guard; replace one slot atomically.
functions.limitation: Single serialized writer contract; no cross-slot atomicity or complete-market proof.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: TopVolumeRuntime::load
functions.behavior: Load one immutable family/cadence snapshot handle.
functions.limitation: Can return stale or empty board; caller must choose freshness policy.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: TopVolumeRuntime::load_fresh
functions.behavior: Reject missing/empty/future/too-old board or negative age limit.
functions.complexity: Independent ofR; constant checks after slot load
functions.limitation: Only validates snapshot-label age, not per-instrument freshness, feed health or complete coverage. No production trading reader exists.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: TopVolumeSnapshot::first
functions.behavior: Return first already-sorted row without DB/search/sort.
functions.limitation: Reading a winner does not include computing it, risk checks, network transit or order execution.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: TopVolumeRuntime::reset_daily
functions.behavior: Clear eight latest slots while old held Arcs remain valid immutable objects.
functions.complexity: Fixed 8 slot operations; O(T) if cadence count grows
functions.limitation: No atomic reset of all slots together; serialized owner required.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: project_snapshot
functions.behavior: Apply common grid label, checked ID/score conversion, metadata and subscription context.
functions.limitation: Missing gain/label preserves row; invalid signed IDs or arithmetic range can drop it. Per-sweep buffers allocate.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: TopVolumeRankWriter::append_row
functions.behavior: Write one ILP row transactionally relative to buffer using marker/rewind.
functions.limitation: Bad row counts/refuses; no whole-snapshot transaction.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: TopVolumeRankWriter::flush / split_for_offload
functions.behavior: Hand bounded batch to writer thread; full queue retains pending rows for retry.
functions.complexity: Depends on batch bytes and handoff
functions.limitation: Width cap/sink gone can discard snapshots. No snapshot spill tier and no zero-loss history guarantee.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: TopVolumeRankWriterSink::write
functions.behavior: Perform ILP HTTP batch write/ack outside feed-drain network path.
functions.limitation: Database failure can lose periodic snapshot history while RAM selection continues.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: ensure_top_volume_rank_table
functions.behavior: Rename known legacy table, create/alter missing columns and enable composite UPSERT key.
functions.complexity: Fixed schema statements plus remote I/O
functions.limitation: Fail-soft retries can leave DEDUP unavailable; old rank column is not automatically dropped.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: top_volume_cadence_view_ddl
functions.behavior: Create per-cadence SQL projection with LEFT JOIN labels and deterministic newest/group/exact-volume ordering.
functions.complexity: Query work/memory grow with selected population
functions.limitation: No automatic ordering guarantee for arbitrary SELECT from base table. SQL engine execution remains a release gate.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: top_volume_exact_ratio_order_sql
functions.behavior: Generate valid-domain flag, integer ratio part and64 fraction bits in signed-safe31 + 31 + 2 limbs, descending.
functions.complexity: O(1) arithmetic expressions/row, then SQL sort over selected rows
functions.limitation: Exact only positive u32 numerator/denominator; invalid legacy rows remain visible after valid rows in same snapshot/family. No new rank column.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

functions.name: global_top_volume_runtime
functions.behavior: Return process-wide OnceLock-initialized eight-slot RAM runtime.
functions.complexity: Constant slot-store handle access after init
functions.limitation: Source search found publication/reset and tests only: no production API/frontend/order-strategy consumer.
functions.evidence: source-inspected; production execution of candidate pending

scenario_matrix.behavior: Baseline seeds to first known cumulative. Earlier activity is unknown; it is not invented as this window volume.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Same percentage display, different exact fractions
scenario_matrix.behavior: Candidate compares delta/lot exactly; higher true ratio wins even if both display 42.5%.
Candidate retains row even if display milli-lots=0 and displayed percentage=-100%.
security_id then segment enum ordinal ascending only stabilize ties.
scenario_matrix.status: candidate comparator; no other market signal changes primary order

scenario_matrix.behavior: RAM publishes explicit empty board; load_fresh refuses it. DB receives no rows for that empty board.
scenario_matrix.status: implemented; DB absence alone cannot distinguish quiet from failed write

scenario_matrix.scenario: Missing lot size or contract owner
scenario_matrix.behavior: Refuse ranking input, count relevant metadata/owner refusals where supported.
Keep volume row with NULL contextual gain; stock depth candidate is Unknown and excluded.
Observer treats equal as unchanged; candle incremental delta=0.
scenario_matrix.status: implemented; ticks may still record received snapshots with capture identity

scenario_matrix.behavior: Ranking refuses lower values until 32 lower observations trigger re-latch; candle path uses different large-drop restart heuristic.
scenario_matrix.status: known semantic gap; no universal reset inference

scenario_matrix.scenario: Counter dip followed by staircase recovery
scenario_matrix.behavior: Ranking source records a residual phantom-delta possibility during staged recovery.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Large counter restart with pending late carry
scenario_matrix.behavior: Phase2 rebase preserves counted pending carry before rebasing open/sealed cell state. Reset tick delta itself is unknown.
scenario_matrix.status: candidate fix; new Rust cases unexecuted in this dictionary

scenario_matrix.behavior: Candles prefer bounded-plausible receipt clock; late policy can amend retained bucket or account a discard/carry.
scenario_matrix.status: implemented policy; not perfect exchange-time attribution

scenario_matrix.behavior: Next rank measures cumulative difference since last actual sweep and labels current grid. Missing individual prior ranks cannot be recovered from latest counter.
Rank ts labels publication boundary; candle ts labels bucket open. Nominal prior 5s rank at09:15:05 relates to candle09:15:00, not same-ts candle.
RAM refuses older/future-at-read snapshot; timer reanchor reduces drift. Existing row data still not a formal complete-window proof.
scenario_matrix.status: implemented guards; timing correctness not absolute

scenario_matrix.scenario: All stocks falling or gain unavailable
scenario_matrix.behavior: Full volume board still records volume; stock-depth gainer candidate list can be empty and existing held sockets can remain.

scenario_matrix.scenario: One underlying owns hundreds of highest rows
scenario_matrix.behavior: Depth200 distinct-underlying selection scans full eligible ranked population independently of depth20 cut.
scenario_matrix.status: phase2 candidate fix; prevents shared-cap truncation

scenario_matrix.behavior: Eight slots are independently published; each immutable board coherent, multiple loads can be from different sweeps.

scenario_matrix.scenario: A fresh board includes stale individual input
scenario_matrix.behavior: load_fresh checks board timestamp only; it does not prove instrument latest tick age or complete feed state.
Ranking and latest RAM board do not query DB. Bounded offload snapshots can lose history on width cap/sink failure.
scenario_matrix.status: implemented isolation; no lossless snapshot audit claim

scenario_matrix.behavior: Finite queues and disk cannot retain unbounded traffic/outage. Replay protects only surviving captured data; provider gaps may not be replayable.
Ranking has25,000 slots per family; candle engine25,000 total instrument slots. Some ticks can persist even when candles/ranking excluded by slot exhaustion.
Current four ranking baseline slots and four SQL views do not cover 20 other candle variants.
scenario_matrix.status: not implemented; needs common bucketed producer and bounded capacity design

scenario_matrix.behavior: No top-volume HTTP/WebSocket API/frontend consumer found. UI distribution load was not tested.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Every source trade requested with never-disconnect promise
scenario_matrix.behavior: Dhan API snapshots are not a guaranteed exchange trade tape. Network/provider outages cannot be prevented universally.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Database query without explicit ORDER BY
scenario_matrix.behavior: Base top_volume has no inherent physical percentage sort; use verified view/explicit bounded query.
View uses current lifecycle labels; base contract string remains written label.

scenario_matrix.scenario: Candidate exact-SQL data outside positive u32 domain
scenario_matrix.behavior: Rows remain visible after valid domain rows within own timestamp/family; safe substitute divisor prevents zero division.
scenario_matrix.status: candidate policy; live SQL execution pending

proposed_followups.reason: A timestamp alone cannot distinguish full bucket, partial start, late correction, delayed merged sweep or stale instrument.

proposed_followups.proposal: Add a RAM-only signal reader that refuses unready/stale/incomplete snapshots and emits observable decision intents; integrate actual order execution only through established risk/idempotency controls.
proposed_followups.reason: The current first-row accessor is not an automated trading strategy.

proposed_followups.proposal: Record a snapshot manifest with expected/appended/acknowledged row counts and completeness.
proposed_followups.reason: No rows currently means either quiet board or failed snapshot persistence; base row table cannot distinguish.

proposed_followups.proposal: Validate original Dhan volume units, replay limitations and every-packet coverage against raw capture and independent provider contract.
proposed_followups.reason: A cumulative counter can recover quantity across a gap but not each lost trade price/timestamp/side.
